sections.title: # Digital Library
sections.content: A well equipped Digital Library provides access to a large number of electronic resources in all disciplines. e-Library is a large e-resource center that helps to access e-databases of Journals , books and reference material subscribed by the college. The library organizes Orientation programmes connecting these resources with the objective of raising awareness among the students, staff and research scholars on how to use the e-resources.
